findings: 18m post-close measurement directly observed 117s operational close duration, but it is explicitly contaminated high-side by corrective rewrite and extra instrumentation; it is diagnostic and cannot be used as a representative normal reserve estimator without replication.
The 32s direct sample remains the only normal promoted close-overhead sample in current state.
Therefore a 60s provisional reserve is plausible but weakly supported; a future W7 CLOSE_HEAVY replication is required before promotion.

For admission logic, a 60s reserve would leave normal-task admission frontiers at remaining_budget > estimated_task+60s; using 117s as a conservative anomaly bound would shift the frontier 57s earlier. This difference is large enough that close-reserve uncertainty materially affects PRODUCTIVE_CAP and must be measured rather than assumed.
